entities.summary: Giullian Yao Gioiello is an American actor, musician and songwriter. He is known for his portrayal of Gus in the Playhouse Disney/Netflix series Julie's Greenroom, BB on Marvel's Iron Fist, and Manny in VH1's Scream. He also officially released his first single "Goodnight Baby" on January 16, 2019, on streaming platforms under the name Tarune through an Instagram post. He has since released several other singles as a singer-songwriter, which have accumulated over 13 million streams on Spotify as of June 10, 2024.
